summary: Combines a backend settings profile with an AuthProfile from mountainash_auth_client. build_driver_kwargs() and build_connection_string() check supported_auth and apply the registered auth adapter or URL applier. provider_for_dialect() and provider_for_scheme() map an Ibis dialect or URL scheme back to a CONST_DB_PROVIDER_TYPE, and apply_auth_adapter() applies auth without a profile.
extension_points: _URL_APPLIERS maps (provider, auth type) to a URL builder for non-password URL auth (currently MotherDuck token).
Auth adapters are looked up with settings.adapters.registry.auth_adapter(provider, auth type).
lifecycle_notes: Shared ibis dialects (postgres for PostgreSQL/Redshift, duckdb for DuckDB/MotherDuck) resolve deterministically to the canonical provider whose name matches the dialect.
documentation_hooks: Layering diagram: settings profile (config) + AuthProfile (credentials) -> driver kwargs or URL.
Which auth forms have a URL rendering and which raise NotImplementedError.
risks: build_connection_string supports only no-auth, password, and per-provider appliers; other auth types raise NotImplementedError for URL output.
The module ID is the factories package, but only ConnectionFactory exists; the CLAUDE.md mention of OperationsFactory and SettingsFactory does not match the source.

evidence.detail: IbisBackend uses the factory to build kwargs/URLs
